meta.name: qdrant-sizing
meta.description: Sizes a Qdrant deployment before it is provisioned. Use when someone asks 'how much RAM do I need', 'how many nodes', 'how big should my cluster be', 'sizing', 'capacity planning', 'will N vectors fit', 'what instance type should I pick', or gives a vector count and dimensions and asks what to provision. Also use when an existing estimate needs checking before hardware or a cluster tier is bought.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 估算 Qdrant 部署所需内存与节点数
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在规划 Qdrant 集群规模,需要预估内存与节点数。
copy.tagline_en: Estimate the memory and nodes needed for a Qdrant deployment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning a Qdrant cluster and need to estimate memory and node count.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在部署前帮你估算 Qdrant 所需的内存、磁盘、CPU/GPU 核数和节点数,并提醒考虑副本、量化、负载等额外开销。
howto.when: 当你说出“需要多少内存/节点”、提到“容量规划/扩容”,或给出向量数量与维度询问如何配置时触发;也用于购买前核对已有估算。

say.text: 我有 5000 万条 768 维向量,需要多大内存?
say.note: 它会按公式估算内存占用。

say.text: 3 副本的 Qdrant 集群需要几个节点?
say.note: 它会考虑副本和容灾来给节点数。

say.text: 2 节点 64GB 配置够用吗?帮我核对下
say.note: 它会核对现有估算再给结论。

howto.what_en: Before provisioning Qdrant, it estimates RAM, disk, CPU/GPU cores, and node count from workload requirements, and flags extra overhead such as replication, quantization, and load.
howto.when_en: Triggered by questions about RAM, nodes, cluster size, capacity planning, or vector count/dimensions; also used to check an existing estimate before buying hardware.

say_en.text: I have 50M 768-dim vectors. How much RAM do I need?
How many nodes for a 3-replica Qdrant cluster?
say_en.note: It accounts for replication and fault tolerance.

say_en.text: Is a 2-node 64GB setup enough? Please check.
say_en.note: It validates the estimate before provisioning.
